formal_claims.signature: theorem protectedEmbedding_injective {A X : Type} (p : ProtectedEmbedding A X) : Function.Injective p.embed
theorem protectedGrowth_recovers {X Y : Type} (source : ProtectedTen X) (target : ProtectedTen Y) (g : ProtectedGrowth X Y source target) (i : TenIndex) : target.recover (g.step (source.embed i)) = i

theorem protectedGrowth_preserves_distinction {X Y : Type} (source : ProtectedTen X) (target : ProtectedTen Y) (g : ProtectedGrowth X Y source target) (i j : TenIndex) (hij : i ≠ j) : g.step (source.embed i) ≠ g.step (source.embed j)

theorem protectedTen_no_collapse_under_map {X Y : Type} (p : ProtectedTen X) (q : X → Y) (recoverY : Y → TenIndex) (hrecover : ∀ i, recoverY (q (p.embed i)) = i) : Function.Injective (fun i => q (p.embed i))
